correctness.rationale: For X=|C+m|, differentiating x^2 f_X(x) gives [4x/(π d_-(x)^2 d_+(x)^2)] [(1−3m²)x⁴+2(1+m²)²x²+(1+m²)³]. It is positive at all x>0 iff |m|≤1/√3; beyond that the leading coefficient is negative. Conditioning on an independent positive stable scale preserves concavity of G_X(t)=Pr(X>1/t). The characteristic function of T_alpha(C+m) is exp(−(|t|−imt)^alpha), and identifying the strictly alpha-stable scale and skewness yields beta=tan(alpha arctan m)/tan(πα/2) with the stated sufficient band for 0<alpha<1. alpha=1 is separately the shifted Cauchy. Domain/endpoint/scope and essential infimum are explicit. Newly derived symbolic derivative and 64 independent characteristic-function comparisons passed; the continuum assertion rests on the analytic proof.
